stemMd: What additional detail did interviewers begin asking for?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Proof that no cars had ever crossed the square.

options.label: B
options.textMd: A replacement of all spoken accounts with fictional stories.

options.label: C
options.textMd: A promise that every narrator would agree.

options.label: E
options.textMd: More precise context for when and how remembered experiences occurred.

explanationMd: Interviewers asked narrators to locate memories more precisely, addressing period, time of day and mobility experience. This contextualization helped explain some disagreements without forcing agreement.

distractorRationale.d: The added context concerned memories and use of the square.
distractorRationale.a: Traffic was part of some residents’ experience.
distractorRationale.b: The exhibition retained the contrasting oral histories.
